links.comparator_used: Raw ASR transcription output (GPT4oTranscribe) without LLM error correction
links.outcome: Proportion of transcript-outputs containing at least one clinically significant Class 3 error
links.effect: Proportion of transcript-outputs affected fell from 53% to 30%. Of 89 clinically significant errors in ASR-output, 51 were resolved, 38 remained significant and 4 were newly introduced.
links.tradeoff: The LLM correction introduced new clinically significant errors in 3% of transcript-outputs (4 newly introduced errors), and 38 significant errors remained.
links.quote: LLM-processing reduced the proportion of transcript-outputs affected (53% to 30%), amongst 89 clinically significant errors in ASR-output, 51 were resolved, 38 remained significant and 4 were newly introduced.

design_hint: LLM-based generative error correction of ASR transcripts
